claim_scope: Supplied HTML section6.3, using its displayed G/(G-1) CR1 factor.
assumptions: Same parameter coordinates, units, A and B in both covariance calculations.
Added groups have exactly zero scores and do not alter A or B.
Finite independent-group counts G >= Gstar >= 2; nonzero finite old SE.
bound: 1 <= corrected_SE/old_SE < sqrt(2) for finite counts; sqrt(2) is the supremum as Gstar=2 and G grows.
justification: g/(g-1) decreases from2 toward1 for g>=2; therefore1<=factor(Gstar)/factor(G)<2.
conclusion: The CR1 count multiplier alone cannot explain orders-of-magnitude SE deflation or an SE near1e-17 starting from an ordinary-scale SE.
limits: This is a conditional formula check, not attribution of actual package failures.
Changes to information, scores, constraints, rank, parameter units or other finite-sample factors require separate analysis.
Existing nobs and R3STEP empty-person repairs are distinct and are not undone or reinterpreted by this bound.
